amazon_pa.task: Go to amazon.com/s?k=student+laptops and collect the first 50 laptop listings. For each: extract full product name, RAM, storage, GPU, price in USD, and product URL.

techspecs.description: TechSpecs API — real hardware specs (weight, display, battery, RAM, CPU, GPU). Free tier at techspecs.io. Env vars: TECHSPECS_API_KEY + TECHSPECS_API_ID

rainforest.description: Rainforest API — Amazon prices + ratings via env var RAINFOREST_API_KEY
